reason: I buy one big cheap bag of dry food with the groceries and that is it; wet food is a once-in-a-while treat I pick up from the same shelf. RM 19.90 for 1kg is about double what I pay per kilo, and I am not going to message a Facebook page to order cat food.
objection: Where is it made? New brand, cartoon cats, 'no pork ingredients', but nobody says which country or factory it comes from. I am not feeding my cat something I cannot trace.
would_change_my_mind: Country of origin printed clearly on the pack, plus a big bag (7kg or more) on a pet shop shelf at a per-kilo price that matches what I pay now.
